servicesSub: Not sure where to start? Call 0405 363 578.

services.title: Student visas & study
services.long: Counselling for international students, help choosing a course and preparing the student visa application, plus advice on the cost of living.

services.title: Skilled migration
services.long: Help with skilled migration, including skills assessments and the Professional Year (PY) pathway.

services.title: Work visas
services.long: Advice on working visas and employment services for people building a career in Australia.

services.title: Partner visas
services.short: Be with the one you love.
services.long: Help preparing partner visa applications and the evidence that goes with them.

services.title: Visitor visas
services.long: Visitor and tourist visa applications for family visits and holidays in Australia.

services.title: OSHC & paperwork
services.long: Help arranging Overseas Student Health Cover (OSHC) and getting your documents and forms in order at every step.

whyText: Advisapro has been helping people study and migrate to Australia since 2015 (first as Neptune Visa Services). The multilingual team explains each step in your language.

Have you always been called Advisapro?
Advisapro started in 2021. Before that the business was Neptune Visa Services, set up in 2015.
Call 0405 363 578 or send the form on our contact page.

aboutParas: Advisapro Migration and Education Services is an Australian-owned business at Unit 3, 153 Haldon Street, Lakemba.
It began in 2015 as Neptune Visa Services and became Advisapro in 2021. The team helps with student, skilled, work, partner and visitor visas, skills assessments and study counselling.
The team speaks Gujarati, Hindi and Urdu, so you can talk through your plans in the language you are most comfortable with.
